question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Rife
solution:
The correct answer is **Scarce.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "rife" means** abundant, widespread or numerous. **(फैली हुई; बहुविदित)
 
• The most appropriate antonym is Scarce.
 
• Rife meaning is** ****of common occurrence; widespread**.
 
• Thus the correct answer is **Scarce.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Scarce** means are **insufficient for the demand. (**दुर्लभ)
 
• **Ripe** means **developed to the point of readiness for harvesting and eating. **(फल, अनाज आदि) पका हुआ)
 
• **Popular **means **liked or admired by a large or specific group of people. **(लोकप्रिय)
 
• **Serene** means **calm, peaceful, and untroubled; tranquil**. (शांत और गंभीर)
